findings.summary: Sequential credential-head allocation writes metadata rejected by its reader, blocking shared identity/status/sync/logout (NFR-008, FR-016).

Browser decoders impose bounds smaller than valid backend data; names/environment fixed, but generic10000 row cap rejects unbounded administrator users/groups/assignments (FR-001/003/022, AC-001/011).
Independent admin reads pair stale membership/account data with newer configuration revision, allowing silent revocation resurrection (NFR-004).
Line-based argument/environment drafts silently change valid structured commands or prevent unrelated saves (FR-003/022, AC-011).
